newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BIG JUMP IN AIR PASSENGERS IN SOUTH AFRICA.
newsitem.headline: BIG JUMP IN AIR PASSENGERS IN SOUTH AFRICA.

text.p: South Africa's six major airports recorded a 15 percent increase in passengers from 1994 to 1995, Transport Minister Mac Maharaj said on Monday.

He said in a written reply to a parliamentary question that 12.5 million passengers used the airports in 1994, the year South Africa held its first all-race election and began emerging from isolation, against 14.4 million last year.
Foreign tourism and business travel to South Africa increased sharply last year but have since levelled off, partly due to fears over crime, travel industry players say.
